# Fixed official Palomar metadata contract

The scripts, taxonomies, and MIT license in this directory are copied from
PalomarRegistry/PalomarSubmission at d4e41c1d5b0d114c4859e6e5831dc6d3ad1d0d44.
Their original license remains in LICENSE. This is a local mechanical metadata
preflight, not an invocation of the Palomar service or a claim of registration.
Only load_formalization_metadata(Path) is called by the root wrapper. No ORCID
network-validation operation is requested by that wrapper.
